description: ABB free@home SysAP — policy-only module for firewall rules (no VM)
_comment_zoning: ADR-COM-0006/0007: SysAP, the Zigbee gateway (deconz+diyHue) and the real Philips Hue bridge are co-located in iotCloud. The SysAP consumes two Hue bridges INTRA-zone: deconz:hue-bridge (diyHue, the ConBee/IKEA fleet — genuine-grade emulation, since deCONZ-direct was rejected by free@home) and hue:bridge (the real Philips Hue bridge, its own lamps). HA controls the Zigbee fleet via deconz:zigbee (native, srvHome->iotCloud) — not through diyHue.
